I originally posted on GAF roughly ten years ago. I readily admit it wasn't perfect, but I enjoyed a vast majority of the community. So why the decline and why has it become an Internet laughingstock? I will try to articulate why GAF is currently a hivemind of intolerant, awkward, pearl clutching, and hand waving miscreants who formed a small echo chamber in a community and expanded that very echo chamber until it became the community itself.

1) The genesis of corrupt moderation.

Dragona was one of the first signs that the forum was changing a new guard. A thin skinned feminist who would ban members for using the word "cunt" or for making lame women can't drive jokes, Dragona was obviously made a mod to fill a quota. That particular mod was finally ousted after posters started to warn other posters with, "I'd delete or change your post before Dragona sees it or you're going to get banned." Now the entire moderation staff acts this way and Malka has allowed his motley crew of SJWs to ban their way into pushing a narrative. Let us not forget that shining examples of humanity like Amirox was a moderator and now we have blatant Hillary shills and black father of year candidates who don't pay child support.

2) Devolution and the BCT.

GAF's very own Anita Sarkeesian. She later quit posting because she grew tired, but not before ruining entire threads with feminist and SJW shit posting. Ever the attention whore, she would frequent the BCT like a fatherless white girl in a ghetto crack den. She gathered a lot of cheerleaders and white knights and entire threads became her and her legion of cucks arguing with anyone who disagreed with their agenda. Does this sound familiar? It should because this is what the forum is now. The spread of radical feminism and the empowering of the BCT can solely be placed on Malka and Devolution, Lime, bishopti, Lui Kang, etc. It's no surprise that most of these people are some of the most prominent posters on the site. Malka let this get out of control and tried to temporarily close the BCT thread but was overruled by his own moderation team. So good luck, you gave these professional victims an inch and they took over your entire site. The entire Off Topic side now functions as the BCT thread and Devolution (the original militant feminist poster) worked with the homies to make sure the cancer spread.

3) The line in the sand: gamer gate.

The true jump the shark moment, GAF made it clear it wasn't interested in any discourse regarding the subject. A mass ban sweep was engaged by SJW moderation and the forum has and never will recover. If you can't counter argue and put up a fight the most logical course of action is to simply ban everyone you disagree with. This absolutely empowered certain posters on the site and now posting any slightly politically incorrect post is like walking through a field of land mines. Witch hunts, tattle telling, victim complexes, silencing opposition via ban, shit posting, etc. All of this increased tenfold after Gamer Gate.

So there you have it. That's my observation on the swift decline of the site. It mainly deals with power hungry, biased moderation who are pushing an agenda with the limited power they yield. A powerless owner who created Frankenstein, let it wreak havoc, and now wonders why the numbers are down and his forum resembles a giant hug box complete with trigger warnings, safe spaces, and militant minorities.
